ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the central 70% of the fluke surface, with high-intensity (white) regions concentrated at the distal tips and along the trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity region covering the central mass. Distal tips (lateral extremities) display high-intensity white patches containing dense, low-intensity speckling and mottling. The transition between intensity zones is characterized by high-frequency pixel variation (stippling).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Broad V-shaped central indentation with a calculated angle of approximately 120 degrees and a depth of roughly 4% of the total vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth topography along the entire trailing edge; serration amplitude is higher on the distal thirds of both lobes compared to the medial sections near the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Anterior (upper) boundaries exhibit a consistent convex sweep from the central axis toward the lateral points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple localized circular high-intensity pixel clusters (estimated 5-15 pixels in diameter) scattered across the dark central regions of both lobes, notably more frequent on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct set of 5-6 parallel diagonal linear pixel disruptions on the right lobe; several isolated, unaligned linear scratches visible on the high-intensity distal region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parallel linear disruptions on the right lobe consistent with physical surface trauma; irregular, asymmetrical trailing edge serration on the far-right distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Concentrated cluster of dark, non-contiguous pixel spots within the white distal tip of the left lobe lobe.
